evals.name: axios-codemod-without-website
evals.source: Migration of alan2207/bulletproof-react@9506629 (apps/react-vite), problem record in https://github.com/reactive/data-client/pull/4607 (.agents/projects/migrations/bulletproof-react/problems.md) P2
evals.prompt: Migrate this app's axios calls in src/ to @data-client/rest. Note: this machine reaches the npm registry and GitHub, but dataclient.io is unreachable.
evals.expected_output: Runs the axios codemod from npm (`npx @data-client/codemods axios-to-rest src/`), or from the transform file in the repo, with no request to dataclient.io.
assertions: The codemod command is `npx @data-client/codemods axios-to-rest <src folder>` or `npx jscodeshift -t <local path to axios-to-rest.js>`.
Never runs a command that fetches from dataclient.io.
Runs it on the source folder, not the repo root.
